$comment: Plain words for the treatment detail lines of the visit summary (docs/plans/visit-story-v2-offers-design.md, section 1.2). Each line states only a recorded fact: 'procedures' names a seeded chart procedure, 'why' a finding recorded on that tooth (chart finding or finding chip id), 'material_today' the material stored on today's chart entry. A key that is not here gives no line. English only; reviewed by: pending (founder).

why.caries: decay was found on this tooth
why.deep_caries: deep decay was found on this tooth
why.abscess: an infection was found at the root of this tooth
why.near_pulp: decay close to the nerve was found on this tooth

material_today.calcium_hydroxide: a medicine (calcium hydroxide) was placed inside the tooth
material_today.mta: a medicine (MTA) was placed inside the tooth
material_today.glass_ionomer: filled with a tooth-coloured filling (glass ionomer)
material_today.gutta_percha: the root was filled and sealed (gutta-percha)
